unproved_sufficient_lemma_v1: For -b<t<0, b=1-1/sqrt(2), let h have even degree d>=2, positive leading coefficient and d simple roots in (-1,0). Set delta=(1+2t)/(1+t)^2. If 0<lambda<=1/(h'(0)/h(0)+delta), then T_t^2[(z-lambda)h] has d+2 simple roots in (-1,0) and one simple positive root.
